newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar edges higher ahead of close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar edges higher ahead of close.

text.p: LIFFE white sugar futures crept higher late on Tuesday after trading in a tight range throughout the day.
By the close, May was $1.00 stronger at $311.00 per tonne, the day's high, while August was 20 cents firmer at $308.00.
Trading was dominated by cross and switch trades in a market preparing for the expiry of the spot May contract on April 15, traders said.
But prices failed to stray from a narrow range between $311.00 and $309.80.
Volume was heavy at 3,804 lots, mostly coming from nearby May/August crosses coupled with a sprinkling of against actuals trades.
In Paris the May contract was up 30 cents at $310.20, while August was down 20 cents at $307.20.
